Jeevan ek natak hai; apana kirdar achhe se nibhao.
Bhoolna insaan ka swabhaav hai; bhool mein rehna moorhta hai.
Langar sirf gahre paani mein tike.
Sabse gehra dukh shant mukhota pehenta hai.
Chalak dimaag jhukta hai jahan kathor toot jata hai.
Dil dimaag ke khilaf ek baaghi hai.
Ahankar se bharne par aatma ki naav chhed ho jaati hai.
Azaad insaan kisi ka gulam nahi hota.
Gyan apni agyanta ki gehrai ko janana hai.
Chalak dimaag ek poori sena ko maat de deta hai.
Chalak dimaag qabr mein bhi roshni dhoondh leta hai.
Pachhatawa keedo ka bhojan hai.
Chalak lomdi chare se pehle jaal ki bu soonghti hai.
Log wahi dekhte hain jo unka dimaag karne deta hai.
Ek prasann swabhaav sabse sakht toofaan ko jeetta hai.
Dimaag ek jahaj hai jo anjaane samandar par chalta hai.
Ahankar wo langar hai jo chattan par ghiste hai.
Jo prashansa bachaaye, vah apana gun bhookha rakhe.
Sankhyaayein brahmand par raj kare.
Chalak dimaag registan me bhi paani dhoond leta hai.
Log khoon se sona kharidte hain, par ahankar ke liye bechte hain.
Hum taaron se chalte hain, par andhere me thokar khate hain.
Bhavnayein andar ke samrajya par raaj karti hain.
Chalak dhokebaaz moorkhon ka mukut pehenta hai.
Rooh un sachhaiyon ke liye tadapti hai jo boli na jayein.
Ek khushnuma geet adharat toofaan ko chunauti deta hai.
Paani kathor se kathor patthar ko bhi kaat deta hai.
Ek chatur baat moorkh din ko sudhar deti hai.
Dil ke paas wo wajehein hain jo vichar nahi jaante.
Jo ujaale se bhage, chhaya unka peecha kare.
Gyan sadagi ka chola pehenta hai.
Gahra kuan sabse meetha paani de.
Darshan se pahle jyotish/rekhaaganit.
Daya devataon ki asli mudra hai.
Chalak lomdi chhupe hue jaal se bach jaati hai.
Ek prasann swabhaav sabse accha samaan hai.
Hum kshitij khojte hain, vartaman se andhe hokar.
Teekhi baat buddhi ki talwar hai.
Bina gyan ke chalaki bina patwar ki naav hai.
Ek chalak chaal samne ke hamle ko maat deti hai.
Insaani dil ek anjaana jangal hai.
Jo apne krodh par kaabu rakhe, wahi beda chalata hai.
Yatra ek akele kadam se shuru ho.
Teekha dimaag jhooth ke jaal ko cheer deta hai.
Chalak chaal brute taakat ko hara deti hai.
Hum prithvi naapte hain, par dimaag nahi naap paate.
